# Next.js Monorepo Standards

Follow these standards when working on frontend applications in this Turborepo monorepo:

## Component Architecture
- Use **Server Components** by default in the Next.js App Router
- Add `'use client'` only when the component requires browser APIs, hooks, or event handlers
- Import shared UI components from `@workspace/ui` — never create local copies

## Data Handling
- Validate all API route inputs with **Zod** schemas
- Never trust `searchParams` or request bodies without parsing
- Use TypeScript strict mode — never use `any`, prefer `unknown` or specific types

## Styling
- Use **Tailwind CSS 4** utility classes via the shared design system
- Follow mobile-first responsive design patterns
- Use design tokens from `packages/ui` for colors, spacing, and typography

## Dependencies
- Use the workspace protocol for internal packages: `"@workspace/ui": "workspace:*"`
- Run `pnpm install` from the monorepo root — never install from an app subdirectory
